subject: Client staging sprint schedule & acceptance calendar
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearwave.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava Robinson <ava.robinson@clearwave.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2029 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff window & target go-live (ClearWave / Redwood)

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our execs liked the latency numbers and the proposed data isolation approach. We want to move forward with a June 30 go-live for a single production route (patient-summary extraction).

Can your team draft a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and an implementation timeline that lays out milestone dates, owners, and acceptance criteria? Key constraints on our side:
- Security review by our InfoSec team (must complete before QA)
- Integration will be done by our Platform team (2 engineers) — they need connector specs by Apr 19
- We want weekly 30-min checkpoints starting Apr 22

I attached our vendor intake and a short list of compliance questions. Please include a recommended canary strategy and a pre-go-live validation checklist in the MAP.

Samir
VP Product, ClearWave Health
[Attachment: ClearWave_vendor_intake.pdf (pdf)]

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearwave.com>
Cc: Ava Robinson <ava.robinson@clearwave.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Apr 2029 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff window & target go-live (ClearWave / Redwood)

Samir — thanks for the clear constraints. Attached is a first-pass MAP and an implementation timeline PDF. High level proposal (summary):

Milestones and dates (proposed):
- 2029-04-22: Project kickoff (30m weekly cadence begins) — Owners: Laura (Redwood), Samir (ClearWave)
- 2029-04-19: Connector spec delivery to ClearWave engineers (we'll share API contract + sample payloads)
- 2029-04-29 to 2029-05-31: Integration development window (ClearWave eng + Ben supporting)
- 2029-06-03 to 2029-06-14: Internal acceptance (smoke tests + functional checks)
- 2029-06-17 to 2029-06-21: Security review buffer (InfoSec sign-off required)
- 2029-06-24 to 2029-06-28: Production canary + runbook dry run (rolling to 5% traffic)
- 2029-06-30: Full go-live (production route active)

Owner matrix (short):
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (CSM) — onboarding, acceptance criteria, customer training
- Redwood: Ben Carter (Solutions Eng) — integration support, connector examples, runbook author
- ClearWave: Samir Patel / Ava Robinson — business owner / technical lead; ClearWave Eng — connector implementation

Acceptance criteria (examples):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms for summary route under test traffic
- Accuracy: extraction F1 >= 0.88 on provided eval set
- Security: InfoSec checklist signed and audit logs enabled

Attachments: MAP_ClearWave_v1.xlsx (detailed milestones + RACI), Implementation_Timeline_v1.pdf (Gantt view), handoff-checklist.txt

Next steps: please confirm the kickoff window (we're flexible between Apr 22–24). If confirmed, Marissa will send recurring invites and Ben will coordinate a connector-spec working session.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_ClearWave_v1.xlsx (xlsx)] [Attachment: Implementation_Timeline_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Apr 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: ClearWave MAP handoff + immediate asks

Team — looping you both in on the ClearWave MAP. Customer wants an Apr 22 kickoff and a Jun 30 go-live. Key asks for our side:
- Ben: please prepare connector-spec working session slides and a small demo of the SDK by Apr 18. Also draft the runbook for a 5% canary.
- Marissa: you'll own the weekly cadence invites and the acceptance-test plan. Draft the acceptance checklist in the MAP spreadsheet (tab: Acceptance).
- I'll own stakeholder alignment and exec updates; I'll also track InfoSec doc delivery from ClearWave.

Risks:
- InfoSec review could push QA later — let's build a one-week buffer into the timeline (I added it as Jun 17–21).
- Connector complexity unknown until the spec session — flag if integration effort > 3 dev-weeks.

Attachments: handoff-checklist.txt (contains pre-kickoff items: env access, test data, IP allowlist).

Can you both confirm you can take these owners? If so I'll lock the kickoff for Apr 22 at 10:00am PT and send calendar invites.

Laura
[Attachment: handoff-checklist.txt (txt)]

From: Ava Robinson <ava.robinson@clearwave.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearwave.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Apr 2029 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff window & target go-live (ClearWave / Redwood)

Laura — thanks, the MAP looks great and the dates are aligned with our internal milestones. Two small asks from our side before kickoff:
1) InfoSec has requested an explicit schedule for the security review; can we move the security review window to 2029-06-10 to 2029-06-14 (one week earlier) so they have time for remediation if needed?
2) We prefer the QA window to be 2029-06-05 to 2029-06-18 (to include a longer overlap with the security review).

Otherwise we approve the MAP and the acceptance criteria you listed — small note on the latency target: our baseline tests show 95th < 350ms; we'd like to include a pre-go-live load test to validate.

Samir and I can make the Apr 22 kickoff at 10:00am PT. Please send calendar invites; also can you include a short pre-kickoff checklist in the invite so engineers know what to prepare?

Ava Robinson
Head of Platform, ClearWave Health

Marissa / Ben — quick update following ClearWave's feedback:
- Security review moved earlier: 2029-06-10 to 2029-06-14
- QA window updated: 2029-06-05 to 2029-06-18
- Kickoff confirmed: 2029-04-22 at 10:00am PT (Samir, Ava, ClearWave Eng attending)

Actions for Marissa: please send the recurring weekly invite (30m) with a pre-kickoff checklist in the description (env access, sample payloads, test credentials, Link to MAP). Also assign the acceptance checklist tasks in the MAP spreadsheet and tag owners.

Actions for Ben: confirm connector-spec working session for Apr 18 at 9:00am PT and attach the SDK example to the Drive folder above.

I've updated the Implementation_Timeline_v1.pdf in Drive (see link) and marked the PR and HubSpot deal RDW-3492 as 'Kickoff scheduled'. Once Marissa sends invites I'll move the deal stage to 'Implementation - Kickoff'.

Laura
